normalized_matching_profile.description: SummaryLocated in the coveted Treasure Sands neighborhood of Miramar Beach, this spacious vacation rental includes a private pool, golf cart, and beach service—perfect for families and large groups. With flexible scheduling, 4 king bedrooms, and relaxing outdoor spaces, it's your ideal coastal getaway.SpaceLocation perks: Pompano Joe’s (0.3 miles), Miramar Regional Beach Access (0.3 miles), Silver Sands Premium Outlets (2.7 miles), Destin Commons (3.0 miles), Henderson Beach State Park (4.3 miles) Floor Configuration Main floor: 1 bedroom (king bed), 1 bedroom (2 twin/twin bunk beds), 1 bedroom (2 full/full bunk beds), 1 full bathroom (pool access), laundry room Upper floor: Kitchen, dining area, living room (pull-out sofa), 1 bedroom (king bed), 1 semi-private bathroom, balcony Top floor: 1 bedroom (king bed, private bath), 1 bedroom (king bed, private bath), laundry room Interior: — Kitchen (drip coffee maker, Keurig, Crockpot, blender, air fryer, cooking utensils, tableware) — 7 Smart TVs with cable (65" in living room) — Central heat and A/C — In-unit washer and dryer (2 sets) — Free WiFi — 2,466 sq. ft. Exterior: — Private 7’x16’ outdoor pool (4’ deep, heat optional) — Fire pit (gas, no wood needed) — Gas grill — Outdoor dining area (8-person dining set) — Multiple balconies — On-site parking for 5 vehicles (1 in garage for golf cart, 4 in driveway)NeighborhoodLocated in the heart of Miramar Beach’s Treasure Sands, this home offers unbeatable access to the Emerald Coast’s white-sand beaches, scenic walking paths, and vibrant coastal attractions. Spend the day shopping at Destin Commons or exploring local dining spots like Pompano Joe’s and The Whale’s Tail. Golfers will enjoy nearby courses, while families can take advantage of the calm Gulf waters perfect for swimming and paddleboarding.TransitA complimentary golf cart makes beach access quick and easy. Walking paths lead directly to Pompano Joe’s and Miramar Regional Beach Access. A car is recommended for exploring greater Destin or Santa Rosa Beach. There’s no public transportation nearby.AccessGuests have full access to the home, including the private pool, balconies, fire pit, grill, and both laundry areas. The garage is reserved for golf cart parking. All other driveway spots are available for guest use.House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees to follow all local, state and federal level mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19. Violations that result in fines based on Guests' actions will be passed on to the Guest. 19. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 20. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 21. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted.Read Less
